decisions.text: No prices in first-contact emails; precise package per price; correct sender addresses; deeper research on contacts.
Founder DM template = Dave's own version (section 7 of BRAIN.md).
Super-brain: all products continuously pushed; Claude leads all processes; Dave = CEO on brand/design/product/concept.

FIRE: warm-engagement method for the 12 founders already reached (comment on their post, then DM/follow-up) before adding more cold contacts. Source: Belkins follow-up study (58.6% of replies come from follow-ups) https://belkins.io/blog/sales-follow-up-statistics ; Valley 2026 LinkedIn benchmarks (cold ~2% vs warm 15–45%, vendor data) https://joinvalley.co/blog/linkedin-reply-rate-benchmarks-2026 . Kill-test: 12 is a small sample; founders flooded; offer may be the issue. Cheapest disproof: 7 days, ~40 Dave-minutes.

learnings.text: Calibrate tone on 1–5 samples before writing a batch.
Check a contact's current role within 7 days before it reaches Dave.
At ~2% cold reply rate, 0 replies from 12 messages is expected, not proof the offer failed; judge after follow-ups.
About 2/3 of council websites and the Innovation Authority site block automated reading from the cloud; council and grants research needs the Chrome route or Dave-visible sources.
Press-covered Israeli rounds Aug–Oct 2026 are mostly already in the list; new founder sourcing needs VC portfolio pages, not news.
